notes: The page is the department's Hall Income Tax page. The Hall income tax was the state's only tax on income (on interest and dividends); the page says it was repealed for periods beginning on or after January 1, 2021, so none applies in 2025. The brackets, surtaxes, deductions and reliefs are therefore empty.
The source prints no standard deduction, personal or dependent exemption, or other income-tax deduction (it describes no income tax in force for 2025).
Social Security treatment: not stated in the source; not found in the source.
The page does not mention pensions or retirement income; not found in the source.
Municipal bond interest treatment: not stated in the source; not found in the source.
Capital gains: the source prints no rate or treatment for gains; not found in the source.
The page carries no tax year; it was retrieved 2026-11-07 and is recorded as tax year 2025 as dispatched.
